CardMaker recreation of the original text of [[Lana Dobreed & •Sacrifice]] (Virtual Set 9, released 6 July 2018). Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text has been found (no copy of the 2018 release slip survives; the earliest archived Set-9.pdf, 25 January 2021, is cut off and unreadable).

Text source: PC card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/3e5a4c7d/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json, commit 3e5a4c7d] (2 March 2021, before the March 2021 errata): “If your character is about to be hit, use 1 Force (free if by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to prevent its forfeit from being reduced for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Disarmed. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel a 'react'. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”

Everything else (frame, art, title, icons, set mark, margin name) follows the PC's own card; no errata mark, since this is the original. Render: swccg.com/cardmaker (spec from <code>/api/card/209_48</code> with this game text, errata mark removed), 12 November 2026.
